answer.rationale: Use in-product activation messaging to reinforce realized value and first meaningful actions among price-sensitive SMB accounts facing the competitor cut. It has demonstrated week-one engagement and activation benefits, whereas targeted promotional pricing produced short-term lift but materially weaker 30-day retention and is explicitly unsuitable as a sustainable-growth response. The current price-driven churn context is not directly tested, so target and monitor the intervention rather than assuming it fully offsets price pressure.
